title: A correlated entrance mixture supports a reusable reaction-event interface
status_authority: Exact selected source bytes and scoped source reports are preserved. This incremental integration does not promote correctness, novelty, physical capability, priority, or practical advantage.
reported_status: The P3 continuation reports a reusable interface for event-time, event-identity, and post-event state distributions, plus an executed finite case with a correlated entrance mixture. Proof and numerical artifacts are present in the selected packet; they are not independently audited or replayed in this integration.
scientific_scope_status: The source describes 73 rules, a two-state controller, and 24 heterogeneous two-state components without constructing 2^25 = 33,554,432 configurations. For its reported one-opening executed class, 256 product components approximate a correlated post-event entrance law in total variation below 3.774e-9; using the retained correlation changes a later event probability from the prediction using true product marginals. The exact filter for changing interfaces and a controlled uncertain-event-time approximation are reported at theorem level for finite local CTMCs. Rare conditioning requires a denominator lower bound.
